subject.title: perf(sessions): reuse parsed transcripts for successor rotation

question: Do maintainers accept SessionManager’s validated complete-entry cache as the warm source for successor transcript rotation?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but this extends cache ownership into a compatibility-sensitive persistent session-state rewrite where stale data would be consequential.

options.title: Approve Cache Reuse
options.body: Accept the bounded metadata-validated cache contract and merge after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Keep Rotation Cold
options.body: Retain the canonical full reader until a more explicit lifecycle-owned snapshot API is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve Cache Reuse
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded metadata-validated cache contract and merge after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the validated transcript cache contract being extended by this PR.
